description: Open-source credit-ledger and billing SDK for AI SaaS applications, with synchronized Python and JavaScript clients.
rules: Keep the Python bursar package and the @zonastery/bursar JavaScript package behaviorally aligned.
Treat python/src/bursar/sql/*.sql as the source of truth for the PostgreSQL schema.
Use the shared tests/parity/expression_cases.json fixture when documenting expression behavior.
Use Python 3.12+ and Node.js 22+ examples unless a page states otherwise.
